GOAL: orient in the workspace before proposing, to avoid copying an existing mechanism.
READ: top-level directory listing only (no files yet).
OBSERVED: see listing result.
REASONING: I need to know whether a repository with an RQ-VAE SID pipeline is present; the task forbids copying existing mechanisms and earlier rounds already rejected successor-weighted Frechet codebook updates, curvature control by prefix-transition score, and behaviour-ranked radial assignment.
OPEN: pick a coupling position none of those rounds measured.

GOAL: choose a coupling position that is not any of the rejected earlier rounds, before writing the block.
READ: workspace listing (only my own progress.jsonl; no repository code is mounted) and the six-round history given in the task.
OBSERVED: rejected/consumed slots are (1) successor-weighted Frechet codebook updates, (2) per-level curvature set by a measured hard prefix-transition score, (3) per-item radial position set by transition-context entropy, (4) successor-profile smoothing + Lorentz, (5) behaviour-ranked radial assignment. Nothing in the history makes the CODE ASSIGNMENT COST itself a behaviour predictive distribution over the hierarchy's own alphabet, and nothing uses geodesic (Poincare) distance as the content term of that assignment with a bounded log-odds margin.
REASONING: a generative recommender consumes a SHARED token vocabulary, so any per-item frame rotation / parallel transport of codebooks destroys token meaning across items (self-rejection of my first candidate, a moving-frame residual). The lever that survives that constraint is which items share which prefix cell. I therefore put the behaviour term as a successor-prefix log-odds margin on a Poincare-distance assignment at all three levels: cells become behaviour states, and the margin magnitude is capped at one typical quantization unit so content cannot be overridden. Curvature is derived from the measured 99th percentile encoder norm, tau from the median nearest-code squared distance, so no constant is swept.
OPEN: nothing; final block appended next.

IDEA: STATECELL-MARGIN-RQ
TITLE: Behaviour-state cells: a successor-prefix log-odds margin on a Poincare-distance RQ-VAE assignment
MOTIVATION: A generative next-item recommender over SIDs is only as good as the prefix transitions it has to predict. In a content-only RQ-VAE, two items that users trade between constantly can land in different level-1 cells, so the generator must spend its first tokens re-identifying a behaviour state instead of predicting the next item. The known behaviour of interest is not the item's own popularity or its own entropy, it is WHERE ITS SUCCESSORS LIVE in the code hierarchy; if an item is placed in the cells its successors occupy, the SID sequence becomes a predictable state chain and prefix-level beam search stops discarding the correct branch early.
NOVELTY: The behaviour term is a predictive distribution over the hierarchy's own alphabet (the current level-l codes of the item's training successors), not a popularity weight, not an entropy-derived radius, not a codebook-update weight and not a per-level curvature control. It enters as a bounded additive margin on the assignment cost, whose content term is a Poincare geodesic distance, so cells become geodesic Voronoi regions shifted by behaviour mass. Nothing in the six earlier rounds computed a successor-code distribution over the codebook alphabet, and nothing used the cap "one typical quantization unit" to keep behaviour from overriding content.
CHANGE: Each RQ level selects its code by argmin over d_P^2(Poincare point of the residual, Poincare point of the code) plus tau_l*(clip(log q / log(1/K),0,1)-1), where q is the count-weighted fraction of the item's training successors that currently sit in that code; tau_l is the level's median nearest-code squared distance, and the successor codes come from a detached one-epoch cache.
SPECIFICATION: Precompute from training sequences only: c_ij = transitions i->j, w_ij = c_ij/sqrt(1+c_j), p_ij = w_ij/sum_j' w_ij, Succ(i) = top-10 by p_ij (full row also allowed). Curvature c = (2*artanh(0.9)/s)^2 with s = 99th percentile of ||enc(x)|| on the first deterministic batch; K = -c, ball radius 1. For level l = 1..3 and batch items i: P_i = exp_0^c(z_i^(l-1)) with z_i^(0)=enc(x_i), C_lk = exp_0^c(e_lk); d2_ik = geodesic distance squared in the ball; n_ik = sum_{j in Succ(i)} p_ij * 1[h_l(j)=k], q_ik = (n_ik + 1/K_l)/(n_i + 1), s_ik = clip(log q_ik / log(1/K_l), 0, 1), cost L_ik = d2_ik + tau_l*(s_ik - 1), tau_l = median_i min_k d2_ik at level initialisation (detached, then frozen); k*(i)=argmin_k L_ik with straight-through selection, z_i^(l) = z_i^(l-1) - e_lk*, decoder loss unchanged, cache h_l updated after the step with the batch's assignments.
COST: Per step at the frozen scale (24556 items, 24 steps/epoch, batch about 1023, K_l = 256, d = 64, 3 levels): 1023*256*3 = 786k geodesic distance evaluations, about 10-20 MFLOP plus 3069 exp/log maps, well under 1 ms of GPU math; extra wall clock per Stage 2 step roughly 5-15% (quantizer math only; the encoder/decoder path is untouched), so 3000 epochs stay inside the frozen budget with no extra epochs and no extra runs. One-off cost: one sparse pass over the training sequences for c_ij and the successor table (minutes, CPU), a 24556-int code cache, and a single deterministic forward pass to measure the curvature scale and the three tau values. Memory: three transient 1023x256 matrices per step.
HYPOTHESIS: If content similarity and behaviour-state co-location are larg

ely compatible in the frozen item embeddings, then adding the capped successor-code margin changes level-1 cell membership for a sizeable minority of items without inflating reconstruction error, the training-only successor prefix-match rate (probability that an item shares its level-1 code with at least one training successor) rises relative to the pure curved baseline, the empirical level-1 code-transition entropy H(code_1(next)|code_1(cur)) falls, and the Stage 3 test recall@10 exceeds the 0.065 target in the single frozen run. If instead successor occupancy is uninformative or the margin is dominated by reconstruction, the successor prefix-match rate stays flat and recall stays at baseline: the idea is then falsified by one run without any ablation.
RISKS: Collapse of many items onto hot successor cells (mitigated by the tau cap, the reconstruction term and the popularity-discounted p_ij, but not proven); the hyperbolic content term itself may cost reconstruction quality because distances near the boundary are dominated by radius; the one-epoch-stale detached code cache can oscillate if codes move fast early; successor structure may be nearly redundant with content similarity, in which case the margin is a no-op; the derived tau could be too weak (behaviour ignored) or at its cap too often (behaviour overrides fine distinctions); the generator may not exploit the improved prefix self-predictability because its own transition head is trained on whatever SIDs it is given.
BEHAVIOR SIGNAL: Directed item-to-item transitions (successor profile) from the training user sequences, popularity-adjusted, restricted to the Stage-2 item set; no self-transitions, no repetitions of the same user within one transition pair.
BEHAVIOR COMPUTATION: One pass over the training split's sequences only: for each adjacent pair (s_u[t], s_u[t+1]) increment c_ij; then w_ij = c_ij/sqrt(1+c_j) with c_j the in-degree, p_ij = w_ij/sum_j' w_ij, keep top-10 successors per item (default) as a frozen sparse CSR block. At each training step the successor codes are read from a detached int cache h_l over all 24556 items, which is refreshed only with the hard assignments of the current batch after the step.
LEAKAGE BOUNDARY: The transition table, the successor lists, the curvature scale s and the per-level tau_l are all measured from the training split and from the frozen Stage-2 item content embeddings; validation and test interactions never enter. The code cache is written only inside Stage-2 training steps from training batches, is detached (no gradient path) and is dropped before Stage 3. Stage 3 consumes only the frozen integer SID strings, so no validation/test interaction can reach the SID construction; the only test-time quantity computed is the final recall.
HYPERBOLIC OPERATOR: Poincare ball distance d_P(u,v) = (2/sqrt(c)) artanh(sqrt(c)||(-u) +_c v||) with fixed negative curvature K = -c, c derived from the 99th percentile encoder norm so that the farthest training item sits at ball radius 0.9; exp_0 and log_0 maps move the residual accumulator and the codebook between the tangent space at the origin and the ball.
HYPERBOLIC LOCATION: Inside the quantization step of every RQ level, in the forward assignment (which code each item takes at levels 1, 2 and 3) and therefore inside the straight-through gradient that reaches the encoder and the codebooks; the decoder and the reconstruction loss stay exactly as in the baseline.
COUPLING PATH: One cost function per l

evel: the geodesic distance from the item's residual point in the ball to the code point produces the content term, the successor-code distribution produces the additive margin, and the argmin of their sum decides the SID token that the generator later sees; setting tau to 0 removes the behaviour and changes the argmin, replacing d_P by the Euclidean distance removes the curvature and changes the argmin, so neither piece survives as a decoration.
COUPLING EQUATION: L_ik^(l) = d_P,c( exp_0^c(z_i^(l-1)), exp_0^c(e_lk) )^2 + tau_l * ( clip( log q_ik^(l) / log(1/K_l), 0, 1 ) - 1 ), with q_ik^(l) = smoothed successor mass of item i currently assigned to code k at level l.
OBSERVABLES: The hard SID strings change for a reported fraction of items relative to the pure curved assignment; the training-only successor prefix-match rate at each level; the empirical level-l code transition entropy and its transfer predictability under a count-based transition model; reconstruction MSE of the RQ-VAE (must stay near baseline); and Stage 3 test recall@10 (the judgement). Prefix counts, entropy of code usage and collisions are reported as diagnostics only.
ABLATION BEHAVIOR OFF: tau_l set to 0 for all levels, so the cost is the pure Poincare-distance assignment: the successor distribution is computed but never enters the argmin.
ABLATION GEOMETRY OFF: d_P^2 replaced by ||z_i^(l-1) - e_lk||^2 with no exp_0/log_0 maps and no curvature, same margin: a Euclidean margin-shifted RQ assignment.
ABLATION BOTH ON: the full coupled run, geodesic distance plus successor-code margin, which is the single arm actually trained.
SPEC EQUATIONS: Precompute p_ij as above; derive c from s; per level: P=exp_0^c(z), C=exp_0^c(e); d2_ik=(2/sqrt(c))*artanh(sqrt(c)*||(-P_i)+_c C_lk||)^2 with the argument clipped to 1-1e-6; n_ik=sum_{j in Succ(i)} p_ij*1[h_l(j)=k]; q_ik=(n_ik+1/K_l)/(n_i+1); s_ik=clip(log q_ik/log(1/K_l),0,1); L_ik=d2_ik+tau_l*(s_ik-1); k*=argmin_k L_ik; forward e*=e_lk*; backward STE: dL/dz += dL/de*, dL/de_lk* += dL/de*; z <- z - e*; h_l(i)=k* after the step. tau_l = median_i(min_k d2_ik) computed once at level initialisation with no gradient. Reconstruction: min ||x_i - dec(sum_l e_lk*)||^2 plus the unchanged baseline terms.
SPEC INPUTS OUTPUTS: Inputs: encoder outputs z_i for a batch, the level codebooks e_l in the tangent space at the origin, the frozen successor CSR block with weights p_ij, the detached code cache h_l, the curvature c and the frozen tau_l. Outputs: per item the three hard code indices (the SID) and the straight-through gradients for the encoder, the codebooks and the decoder; the updated code-cache entries for the batch.
SAFEGUARDS: Ball clipping so every point stays at radius <= 1-1e-5 and the artanh argument is clipped to 1-1e-6; q smoothed with a uniform pseudocount 1/K_l; margin bounded to [-tau_l, 0] so behaviour can never override a content difference larger than one typical quantization unit; tau measured once at initialisation and then frozen so the feedback loop cannot inflate it; successor code cache detached and at most one epoch stale; items with no training successors (or whose successors are outside the Stage-2 item set) get margin 0 and fall back to pure curved assignment; any non-finite d2_ik for an item falls back to the Euclidean distance for that item only; the transition table excludes users with a single interaction and self-pairs; a final assertion that sum_k q_ik = 1 and that all SIDs are within the codebook ranges.
